title: Yields Are Breaking Things… But Stocks May Still Have One More Run
speaker: Chris Vermeulen (inferred from channel; host not named in transcript)

macro_themes.view: 10-year above 5.25%; rising rates will eventually kill the stock market but not yet; bonds in a stage-4 bear market.

macro_themes.theme: Money moving to cash and dollar
macro_themes.view: Cash and the dollar now pay as much as dividend stocks; dollar has more upside, keeping pressure on metals.
S&P bullish percent index near 34%, a level that usually marks a significant low followed by a multi-month rally.
Margin debt at all-time highs signals late-stage bull market; major top possible by end of this year or next, bear market maybe 2027.
Oura and likely Anthropic delaying IPOs because of soft market appetite.

calls.condition: A significant pullback in yields could trigger a bull-flag breakout of 3-4% within four to five sessions; headwinds if rates and oil keep surging.
calls.reason: Long the Nasdaq; tight bull flag, panic selling keeps getting bought, oversold bullish-percent reading; but record margin debt points to a major top by end of year/next year.
calls.quote: I think the market is primed and ready for a move upwards.

calls.condition: If yields pull back significantly, the market may break out of the bull flag (3-4% in 4-5 sessions).
calls.reason: Long the S&P; oversold breadth (bullish percent ~34%) historically precedes multi-month rallies; long-term risk from margin debt.
calls.quote: We're long both the Nasdaq and the S&P 500.

calls.reason: Bonds are in a full stage-4 bear market, so yields keep exploding long term, but yields look overdone and due for a temporary pullback (bonds bounce to resistance/50-day MA).
calls.quote: I do think yields are about to pull back temporarily

calls.reason: Money flowing into the dollar as yields rise; higher interest makes the currency attractive.
calls.quote: There's a lot of upside potential for the dollar itself, the dollar index to keep climbing.

calls.condition: If stocks enter a bear market, metals may get pulled down first, then bottom early and rally while stocks keep falling.
calls.reason: Strong dollar pressures metals; precious metals struggling and get sucked down in risk-off liquidations.
calls.quote: as the dollar keeps moving up, this is going to keep some pressure on metals.

calls.reason: Back at a support level; next 100% measured move target around 120, at the previous high.
calls.quote: I'm expecting this is going to continue to drift and work higher. Our next target, well, our next target is around the 120.

calls.reason: Turned from bear to bull market with a strong uptrend and tight bull flag; 10% upside to 95,000 resistance (he is not taking the trade).
calls.quote: There is 10% upside move to $95,000. I am not taking this trade
